description: Mud, and a dog on the stair

participation.context: Looked at the mud, the boats, and the dog.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a stair he has not yet been offered

story.body: You came down for air and looked at the stair. The dog stayed asleep. You had not yet heard the news.

relations.note: a stair he has not yet been offered

title: Looked at the mud before anyone spoke

description: A penny, and the wrong news

participation.context: Gave the news, offered the boat, and tarred the keel.
participation.name: Davy Gannet

relations.note: a penny offered and not taken

story.body: You heard the three things he believes. You did not buy the crossing. You did not tell him which of the three was wrong. You stayed for the moon.

relations.note: a penny offered and not taken

title: Heard Davy's news at Old Swan stairs

description: The keel, under a moon a day past full

participation.context: Tarred the upturned keel by lantern.
participation.name: Davy Gannet

story.body: You stayed while he tarred the keel. The moon came up behind the Bridge. The thunder he promised did not come. You did not cross.
topics: a moon a day past full

title: Stayed until the moon at Old Swan stairs
